subject: automating the building of a shiny app

messages.author: 06b1e1a23695a937
messages.subject: automating the building of a shiny app
parts:
Hi all,

I am building an app where I may have to update a global dataset from different places within the app.

I have made three gists on a toy problem where:

(1) I have coded all the elements explicitly: https://gist.github.com/ijlyttle/6235528

(2) I have made a closure to automate the generation of reactive functions within server.R: https://gist.github.com/ijlyttle/6235539

(3) I have made a function to generate a list of grouped UI elements within ui.R: https://gist.github.com/ijlyttle/6235554

These gists run for me, and I am hoping I can extend the ideas to more-complicated situations.

I hope this might be useful, and in addition, I will be happy to take any criticism if I am suggesting any bad R or shiny practices (Joe?).

Thanks,

Ian

parts:
That's absolutely fine; very nice.

If you find yourself making reactives within reactives, that's when you need to check yourself. :) There are not many good reasons to do that. But what you're doing is totally kosher.
